prose.name: Rescue: House Call at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A miner at the <Place> hurt his hand and won't come in to the clinic. Someone has to take him a med pack.
prose.card: A miner at the <Place> hurt himself and won't come in to the clinic. Take him a med pack.

beats.objective: Treat the injured miner at the <Place>

person.name: Bram Kessler
hellos: If you're from the clinic, I'm fine.

_bio.from: a miner on the site (his lines)
_bio.why_there: cut arguing with a drill, and won't walk in to the clinic (his lines, the broadcast)
_bio.wants: to not be fussed over, and to get back to work (his lines)

greeting: Don't fuss. It's a scratch. A big scratch. Did they send you with a med pack?

reply: Ow. Right. Thank you. I'd have walked in eventually. Probably.

exchanges.prompt: That needs stitches, not just a pack.
reply: Then stitch it. Quickly, before I look at it.
Arguing with a drill. The drill won.

beats.journal: I patched up a miner at the <Place> with a med pack. He'll live, and he'll complain about it.

broadcast: The patient's a miner who won't come in. Bring a med pack and be patient with him. More patient than he is.
_speech: The dispatcher: fond and exasperated. Bram: gruff, embarrassed. Stand-in voices; his ear decides.
